question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 3 - translates**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage mentions that Nanga Parbat is known as the "naked mountain." The blank refers to the meaning of the name.
 
• The verb **"translates"** means to express the meaning of a word or text in another language. (अनुवाद करना)
 
• Thus, "Nanga Parbat, which translates as 'naked mountain'," is the correct and logical choice.
 
• Other options like "transliterates," "transposed," and "transcribes" do not convey the intended meaning here.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3 - translates**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Transliterates** (लिप्यंतरण करना): Writing words from one script in the letters of another script without changing the meaning.

 
 
• **Example:** "राम" transliterates as "Ram" in English.
 
 
 
• **Transposed** (स्थान बदलना): To change the order or position of something.
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher accidentally transposed the last two digits of the number.
 
 
 
• **Transcribes** (लिखना/प्रतिलिपि बनाना): To make a written copy of spoken words or music.
 
 
• **Example:** The journalist transcribed the interview for the newspaper.
